name: resurgence-protocol-forta-bot
description: Forta detection bot for Resurgence Protocol — monitors for reentrancy attacks, unauthorized upgrades, large claims, and unexpected role changes.
longDescription: Monitors all Resurgence Protocol contracts on Polygon for critical security events: reentrancy attacks, UUPS proxy upgrades, admin role grants not originating from the Timelock, and abnormally large reward claims (>100k RESURGE).

scripts.start:dev: nodemon --watch src --ext js,json --exec "node -e 'const f=require(\"./index\"); console.log(\"Bot loaded\");'"
